notes: FRAGILITY: Medium. Aria-label and href-based nav detection. Instagram SVG path d values for Reels icon may change with tabs redesigns. Friends-Only Mode relies on /?variant=following URL parameter (durable since 2022) plus h1:has() rules for the feed-switcher pill and Back-to-For-You link; redirect runs at document-start via FilterService. Reel URLs (both /reel/<id>/ and /reels/<id>/ — IG 302-redirects the singular form to the plural) are intentionally NOT in blockedURLPatterns: the user must be able to view a reel a friend shared in DM. Single-reel enforcement lives entirely in filter.js: enforceSingleReel() locks to the first reel id seen and bounces on replaceState to a different id (verified: IG fires replaceState, not pushState, when advancing reels), and lockReelsPager() hides every reel slot in the snap-scroll container except the first plus disables overflow and touch on the container so the user can't swipe to the next slot. The Reels tab nav button is unreachable in-app via CSS rules, so the only path into a reel viewer is a friend-shared link in DM. v2.2.0 (2026-05-08): added a synthetic Friends-Only stories peek strip based on rendered feed authors. v2.3.0 (2026-08-19): added the `ads` group. It collapses feed articles only when an exact English, German, or Spanish sponsored marker appears structurally before the first media item, avoiding false positives from ordinary captions. v2.3.1 ignores hidden, pre-mounted dialogs when deciding whether filtering must pause, so inactive auth or composer DOM cannot suppress sponsored-post filtering. v2.3.2 scopes style/class observation to media-bearing Reels transitions on DM and Reels routes, avoids document-wide passes for unrelated animation churn, and ignores the Reels lock's own style writes once the lock is intact. v2.3.3 (2026-08-21): removed the synthetic story row because feed authors do not prove story availability; native Instagram story trays are preserved, and Friends-Only now defaults off with its upstream limitation disclosed. v2.3.4 (2026-08-21): requires multiple viewport-sized portrait videos before classifying a DM scroller as a Reels pager, deduplicates ancestor scans in media-heavy threads, recognizes localized native story trays, and limits structural story-tray detection to Home so DM controls stay usable. v2.3.5 (2026-08-21): rejects accessible live-message transcripts and requires Reel media to occupy most of the candidate pager width, preventing tall shared-video cards from freezing a compact or keyboard-reduced DM viewport. v2.3.6 (2026-09-08): widened the sponsored-marker table to the locale set the Facebook filter already recognizes (adds fr, it, nl, et plus "promoted" and "anzeige"), because Instagram localizes the label to the account language rather than Dull's UI language, and accepted a separator-delimited marker ("Sponsored · ...") which whole-string equality missed. Marker lookup moved from an object literal to an array scan so inherited keys such as "constructor" can no longer read as a match. Reported on UserJot by a lifetime purchaser three days after the ads filter shipped in 1.9.1. v2.3.7 (2026-09-08): the feed-card collapse for reels (CSS article:has(a[href*="/reel/"]) and processArticles()) stood down on single-post routes (/reel/<id>/, /reels/<id>/, /p/<id>/), which filter.js now marks on <html> as data-dull-single-post. A reel shared into Dull from outside opens Instagram's single-post page, itself an <article> full of /reel/ links, and both rules collapsed it into a black body under a "Post" header. Reproduced logged in on the simulator; the DM overlay was never affected because it is not an <article>. v2.4.0 (2026-10-09): ads, suggested and search, from two UserJot reports (one on iOS 26.7.1). Sponsored and "Suggested for you" posts are now found by walking the article header region (every node before the post's main media, avatars excluded) instead of only header span / span[dir=auto]; the feed renders the header as plain divs with the avatar img in it, so the old before-first-media check always lost to the avatar. Labels match whole or as "label · ...", never inside profile or location links, and per-post suggested labels now collapse the post rather than the label. Second ad signal on Home only: an outbound CTA link (l.instagram.com / l.facebook.com shim or a non-Meta host), which organic posts do not have. Suggested sections: the accounts carousel is collapsed as the smallest container with 2+ profile links and 2+ controls; everything after an end-of-feed "Suggested posts" heading is collapsed on every pass; DMs, search and auth routes are excluded. Collapsed elements carry data-dull-collapsed, hidden by an always-on CSS rule, so a React style rewrite cannot un-collapse them. The Explore group no longer hides the magnifier tab, which is the only search entry on mobile web; a tap on it and any bare /explore/ visit go to /explore/search/. Sponsored marker table extended with the uBO uAssets m.facebook.com locale set. 2.3.8 (2026-10-09): Friends-Only story compose. Instagram's Following variant renders no stories tray, and the tray's "Your story" tile is the only story composer entry on the mobile website, so Friends-Only removed story posting. On Following, when no usable native tray is visible, filter.js adds an "add to your story" button that stamps sessionStorage __dullStoryCompose and loads `/`; the document-start redirect lets `/` through for ten minutes and marks <html data-dull-story-compose> before first paint, and filter.css then hides everything except the tray, dialogs or full-screen overlays that appear after a tap in the tray, and Dull's bar. Leaving `/` ends compose. "Add to story" in a post's share sheet is native-app only; instagram.com does not offer it and Dull never hid it. Reported on UserJot.
